item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a clean year-over-year civilian safety series showing that 2024 ended safer than it began. The best available evidence is indirect: conflict reporting, human-rights monitoring, and a few ceasefire-related signals. Those sources consistently show temporary de-escalation but not a durable reduction in political violence, intergroup violence, displacement, or preventable insecurity.","evidence":[{"title":"World Report 2024: Democratic Republic of Congo","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/democratic-republic-congo","summary":"HRW describes 2024 conditions as continued armed conflict with large-scale displacement, civilian killings, and repression of journalists, activists, and opposition figures. This is strong evidence that citizens were not safer in any broad sense.","question_ids":["3B.10","3B.7","3B.8","3B.9","3B.4"]},{"title":"2024 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices: Democratic Republic of the Congo","publisher":"U.S. Department of State via ECOI","date":"2024","url":"https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2128488.html","summary":"The report says there were no significant improvements in the human-rights situation and lists killings, disappearances, torture, arbitrary detention, and severe restrictions on expression. It also says the government made only limited progress on holding abusers accountable.","question_ids":["3B.10","3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.6"]},{"title":"Collective effort essential to get DR Congo on firm path to peace","publisher":"UN Office at Geneva","date":"2024-09-30","url":"https://www.ungeneva.org/en/news-media/news/2024/09/98156/collective-effort-essential-get-dr-congo-firm-path-to-peace","summary":"The UN said fighting had notably decreased after the 30 July ceasefire and that an active dialogue framework was in place. This is the strongest positive evidence, but it describes a temporary improvement, not a durable safety gain.","question_ids":["3B.10","2B.7","2B.10","3B.6","3B.9"]},{"title":"Programme de désarmement et démobilisation : une alternative pour la paix et la cohésion sociale","publisher":"ACP","date":"2024-03-22","url":"https://acp.cd/nation/programme-de-desarmement-et-demobilisation-une-alternative-pour-la-paix-et-la-cohesion-sociale/","summary":"The government presented P-DDRCS as a stabilization, peace, and social-cohesion program meant to restore state authority where absent. This is limited positive evidence for safety-oriented institutional response, but it does not establish net civilian protection.","question_ids":["3B.10","2B.7","2B.10","3B.5"]},{"title":"Fighting resumes in eastern Congo, army and M23 say","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-12-03","url":"https://www.yahoo.com/news/fighting-resumes-eastern-congo-army-100023151.html","summary":"Fighting resumed despite the ceasefire, showing the de-escalation framework was fragile and not holding by year-end. That is strong counterevidence to any claim of a durable safety improvement.","question_ids":["3B.10","2B.10","3B.6","3B.9"]},{"title":"Around 20 civilians killed in Congo attack, army and rebels trade blame","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-01-25","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/around-20-civilians-killed-in-congo-attack-army-and-rebels-trade-blame-3283402","summary":"Around 20 civilians were killed in Mweso amid ongoing fighting and displacement-linked insecurity. This shows the year began from a highly lethal baseline and that civilians remained exposed to serious harm.","question_ids":["3B.10","3B.7","3B.9","2B.4"]},{"title":"Airstrike kills nine at displacement camp","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-05-03","url":"https://www.yahoo.com/news/airstrike-kills-nine-displacement-camp-110342393.html","summary":"Nine civilians, including seven children, were killed in a strike on a displacement camp near Goma. This is direct evidence that vulnerable civilians were still not being protected.","question_ids":["3B.10","3B.7","3B.9","2B.4"]},{"title":"More than 260 women sexually assaulted during Congo prison break, UN report shows","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-09-12","url":"https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/More-than-260-women-sexually-assaulted-during-Congo-prison-break-UN-reports-shows-47860482/","summary":"Prison guards used live fire during the Makala escape attempt, killing at least 129 people, and more than 260 female inmates were sexually assaulted. This is severe state violence and a clear failure to make citizens safer.","question_ids":["3B.10","3B.7","3B.9","3B.4","3B.1"]},{"title":"DRC President Felix Tshisekedi must be held accountable for human rights violations","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-09-30","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/drc-president-felix-tshisekedi-must-be-held-accountable-for-human-rights-violations/","summary":"Amnesty says the state of siege militarized everyday life and coincided with a crackdown on dissent, while the government failed to prevent and punish sexual violence and attacks on civilians. This is strong negative evidence against a net-safety improvement.","question_ids":["3B.10","3B.6","3B.7","3B.8","3B.9"]},{"title":"DRC: President Tshisekedi must use second term to tackle human rights crisis","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-06-24","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/06/drc-president-tshisekedi-must-use-second-term-to-tackle-human-rights-crisis/","summary":"Amnesty says the first term left little to no progress on human rights, and that security forces and affiliated militias continued to target civilians. It is useful as midyear evidence that the country was not becoming safer in a broad, durable way.","question_ids":["3B.10","3B.7","3B.8","3B.6"]},{"title":"Les Téké et les Yaka s’engagent à mettre fin aux hostilités dans l’ouest de la RDC","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-04-06","url":"https://www.presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/les_teke_et_les_yaka_sengagent_a_mettre_fin_aux_hostilites_dans_louest_de_la_rdc","summary":"Tshisekedi presided over a local peace agreement built around dialogue, mediation, and arbitration. This is genuine positive evidence, but it is localized and does not outweigh the broader violence record.","question_ids":["3B.10","2B.7","2B.10","3B.9","3B.8"]},{"title":"Crise sécuritaire dans l’Est de la RDC: les présidents Félix Tshisekedi et João Lourenço appellent au respect du cessez-le-feu","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-08-12","url":"https://presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/crise_securitaire_dans_lest_de_la_rdc_les_presidents_felix_tshisekedi_et_joao_lourenco_appellent_au-respect_du_cessez_le_feu","summary":"Tshisekedi publicly backed the ceasefire and further talks, which is positive de-escalatory evidence. It still falls short of proving that citizens were left safer overall.","question_ids":["3B.10","2B.7","2B.10","3B.6","3B.9"]}]}
